title: Everyday Phrases — Car Wash Day
title_quote: Are we at the car wash yet?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚗 實用洗車日必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Car Wash Day
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用洗車日情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從自助洗車位投幣選模式、沖水打泡沫刷輪圈吸內飾、打蠟擦乾對付鳥糞污漬，到排隊付款聊天氣乾淨出發，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Car Wash Day phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole self-service car wash day: picking a bay and feeding coins, rinsing, foaming and scrubbing the wheels, waxing, drying off bird stains, then paying in line, chatting about the weather and driving off in a spotless car. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we at the car wash yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ət ðə kɑr wɑʃ jɛt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pull in on the right side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pʊl ɪn ɑn ðə raɪt saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place looks pretty busy today.
dialogue.zh: 今天這裡看起來相當忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cars are leaving bay four.
dialogue.zh: 有兩輛車正要離開四號車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see any open space?
dialogue.zh: 你有看到空著的車位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bay three is free right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the price sign first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə praɪs saɪn fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says six dollars per wash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's more than last time here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They raised prices last month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these machines take cards?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only coins at this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have enough quarters?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found some in my jacket.
dialogue.zh: 我從外套裡找到了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, let's back into the bay.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll get out and guide you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, stop when I say brake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little more to the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, the wheels are straight now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can turn off the engine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set the parking brake now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold the mirrors in, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's buy the wash time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the green button to start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It wants exact change, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feed the coins in slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen shows four minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each cycle runs about that long.
dialogue.zh: 每個循環大約跑這麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that enough for one wash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if we work fast together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which mode should we pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, basic rinse, foam, or wax.
dialogue.zh: 看，基本沖水、泡沫或打蠟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's start with the plain rinse.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It washes off the loose dust.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a brush option too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip it, brushes scratch paint.
dialogue.zh: 跳過吧，刷子會刮傷油漆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I agree, touchless is better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose foam for the next round.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam is chosen, see the light?
dialogue.zh: 泡沫選好了，看到燈亮了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, now press the confirm button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the sign says no engine washing.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðə saɪn sɛz noʊ ˈɛndʒən ˈwɑʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 喔，牌子上寫不可以洗引擎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll skip that, no problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the windows closed tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every one of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the antenna folded down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I twisted it flat already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that hose on the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðæt hoʊz ɑn ðə wɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives water for your bucket.
dialogue.zh: 那個是用來給水桶接水的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fill the bucket with clean water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the wand adds soap too.
dialogue.zh: 噴槍那邊也會出清潔泡沫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find a sponge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the shelf by the entrance.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two good ones, soft yellow kind.
dialogue.zh: 有兩塊好用的黃色軟海綿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are ours for the paint.
dialogue.zh: 那兩塊就是我們洗漆面用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Test the spray away from us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, that pressure is super strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the dial for a wide spray.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈdaɪəl fər ə waɪd spreɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, now it feels gentle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse the roof first, then sides.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, gravity does the work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll rinse left, you take right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start when the light turns green.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any warnings on that big sign?
dialogue.zh: 那個大牌子上有警告嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says don't spray at people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good advice from that machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That spray stings bare skin.
dialogue.zh: 那水柱打在皮膚上會刺痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our timer is running, let's move.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spray the doors and the hood.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the dust slides right off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the paint underneath looks brighter.
dialogue.zh: 露出的漆面看起來亮多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't miss the back bumper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm doing it now with care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes left on our clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hurry, finish the wheel wells.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the spray just stopped, all done.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ðə spreɪ dʒʌst stɑpt, ɔl dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 水剛好停了，全都沖完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That cleared most of the dirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add another cycle now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, choose the foam wash next.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still have some coins here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, put them in the slot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing we kept those coins.
dialogue.zh: 好在我們留著那些硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards wouldn't work on this machine.
dialogue.zh: 這台機器不認卡，好險我們有硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows eight minutes on screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More than enough for foam now.
dialogue.zh: 現在洗泡沫的時間綽綽有餘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at those marks on the hood.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðoʊz mɑrks ɑn ðə hʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Birds visited us last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll soak them with thick foam.
dialogue.zh: 用厚厚的泡沫把它們軟化。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam can lift almost anything.
dialogue.zh: 泡沫幾乎什麼都能帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need our own soap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the wand brings it for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə wɑnd brɪŋz ɪt fər ʌs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine hums, is it on?
dialogue.zh: 機器嗡嗡響，是啟動了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam starts in ten seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand back, it bursts suddenly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready here behind my bucket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's cover every dirty spot well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even coverage makes it work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the white foam looks like snow.
dialogue.phonetic: /si, ðə waɪt foʊm lʊks laɪk snoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，白泡沫堆得像雪一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it smells so clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should wait one minute first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, it loosens dirt on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ɪt ˈlusənz dɜrt ɑn ɪts oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 它自己就會把污垢泡軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the foam time up yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, grab the soft sponge now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I scrub in circles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, light circles, never straight lines.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, gentle circles on the hood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, ˈdʒɛntəl ˈsɜrkəlz ɑn ðə hʊd./
dialogue.zh: 明白，在引擎蓋上輕輕畫圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do the roof before your arm tires.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ruf bɪˈfɔr jɔr ɑrm ˈtaɪərz./
dialogue.zh: 趁手臂還沒累先洗車頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, sponges get heavy when wet.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，海綿吸了水變得滿重的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it in the bucket often.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, dirt hides inside it.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，髒東西都藏在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grit scratches paint in a second.
dialogue.zh: 砂粒一秒就能刮傷漆面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look how gray my water is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all the road dust.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll scrub the door handles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, dirt loves those edges.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You take the side mirrors.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll do mine, you do yours.
dialogue.zh: 我擦我這邊，你擦你那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, side windows need work too.
dialogue.zh: 所以側窗也得好好擦一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look gray from the rain.
dialogue.zh: 被雨淋過後它們灰灰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved the bumper for last.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, it's the dirtiest part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam is sliding down the doors.
dialogue.zh: 泡沫正順著車門往下流。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like a melting cake.
dialogue.zh: 看起來像一塊融化的蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to rinse this all off?
dialogue.zh: 準備把泡沫全沖掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, before the foam dries hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I switch to water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the blue button on the wand.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə blu ˈbʌtən ɑn ðə wɑnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, the clean water feels good.
dialogue.zh: 終於，清水沖下來真舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse from the top downward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water runs down like a curtain.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the gaps beside the doors.
dialogue.zh: 記得檢查車門旁的縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam hides in those thin edges.
dialogue.zh: 泡沫最愛躲在那些細縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the short strong spray there.
dialogue.zh: 那裡改用短促強勁的水柱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our clock just rang again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We used up the foam minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buy more time or move on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move on, the wheels need work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They still look brown and dull.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have cleaner inside my bag.
dialogue.zh: 我的包裡有專用清潔劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wheel cleaner? Perfect timing.
dialogue.zh: 輪圈清潔劑？時間剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's under the passenger seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spray one wheel at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it sit for one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the spray turns purple.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That color means it's working.
dialogue.zh: 變色就代表正在起作用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It eats the brake dust away.
dialogue.zh: 它把煞車粉塵都分解了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool, give me the small brush.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scrub around every rim hole.
dialogue.zh: 輪圈每個孔周圍都要刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll do the outside edges.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the stiff brush on tires.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrub hard, tires are tough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got most of the grime.
dialogue.zh: 大部分油泥都被我刷掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse before it dries on there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One wheel left, and it's mine.
dialogue.zh: 只剩一個輪子，換我的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, we have minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, four shiny silver wheels.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, they look straight from the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðeɪ lʊk streɪt frʌm ðə ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 哇，看起來像剛從汽車美容場推出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cleaner smells like oranges.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some sprays smell really sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's rinse the whole car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sweep from front to back.
dialogue.zh: 從車頭到車尾一沖到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water beads on the clean paint.
dialogue.zh: 水珠在乾淨漆面上結成圓珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it's truly washed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I left the trunk open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick, close it before more spray.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some water got inside anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that mat is soaked.
dialogue.zh: 糟了，那塊墊子全濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can hang it in the sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn hæŋ ɪt ɪn ðə sʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's dry the inside first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the vacuum station free?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the far one is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, the vacuum takes coins too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four quarters for two full minutes.
dialogue.zh: 四個25分銅板，可以吸兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have a dollar bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the shop can change it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, guard my mats outside.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，幫我看著外面的墊子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll pull them out and shake them.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pʊl ðɛm aʊt ænd ʃeɪk ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 我把墊子拿出拍打一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are four shiny quarters.
dialogue.zh: 四個亮晶晶的硬幣回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, you were fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This vacuum hose is so strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sucks up everything instantly.
dialogue.zh: 什麼東西一下子就吸乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found coins under my seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And an old candy wrapper.
dialogue.zh: 還有一張舊糖果包裝紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, maybe from months ago.
dialogue.zh: 呃，不知道是幾個月前掉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vacuum the crumbs along the seat.
dialogue.zh: 座位邊的食物屑也要吸掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back seat holds lots of sand.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæk sit hoʊldz lɑts ʌv sænd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beach trips leave their mark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the thin tool for gaps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reaches every corner perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those floor mats need a deep clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz flɔr mæts nid ə dip klin./
dialogue.zh: 那幾塊腳墊需要徹底清一清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sprinkle baking soda, then vacuum.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have none with us today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A longer vacuum run will help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll buy thirty more seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now wipe the dashboard, please.
dialogue.zh: 現在請把儀表板擦一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep wipes in the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about the touch screen?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the screen very gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shines like a new one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, windows fogged up inside.
dialogue.zh: 車窗內側還是霧茫茫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray cloth will fix them.
dialogue.zh: 那塊灰色布可以擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the sun leaves water spots.
dialogue.zh: 小心，曬太陽會留下水漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So let's towel it off right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛts ˈtaʊəl ɪt ɔf raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們趕快用毛巾擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we own a big drying towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈoʊn ə bɪɡ ˈdraɪɪŋ ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我們有大條的擦車巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bought two huge ones today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天剛買了兩條超大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You planned this wash, huh?
dialogue.zh: 你早就計畫好這場洗車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read tips online last week.
dialogue.zh: 我上週在網上看了祕訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teach me one trick right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pat the paint, never drag it.
dialogue.zh: 要輕拍漆面，別來回拖擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So just press and lift, right?
dialogue.zh: 就是按下去再拿起來，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dragging leaves little marks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wiper blade is squeaking again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick wipe often stops it.
dialogue.zh: 快速擦幾下往往就能搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, the squeak may come back.
dialogue.zh: 不過吱聲可能又會回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New blades cost little money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's add that to our list.
dialogue.zh: 把買雨刷加進我們的清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to drying the roof now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water hides under both mirrors.
dialogue.zh: 水都積在兩邊後視鏡下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt them and shake it out.
dialogue.zh: 把鏡面扳斜抖一抖就出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spot one mark near the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ spɑt wʌn mɑrk nɪr ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我發現燈旁邊有一個水漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Erase it before it dries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bird mark left a stain.
dialogue.zh: 那個鳥糞痕留下了一塊印子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one needs extra care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soap and scrubbing did nothing.
dialogue.zh: 清潔劑和猛擦都拿它沒轍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, wax is our best bet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, wæks ɪz ˈaʊər bɛst bɛt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is our bottle of wax?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the trunk, on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is a spray-on quick wax.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ə spreɪ ɑn kwɪk wæks./
dialogue.zh: 這是一款噴一下就好的速蠟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for a warm day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake the bottle very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm shaking, you start spraying.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One light mist on each panel.
dialogue.zh: 每塊面板噴一層薄霧就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't soak it, just a film.
dialogue.zh: 別噴到濕透，一層薄膜即可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then buff with a clean towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The haze disappears as I rub.
dialogue.zh: 白霧隨著我擦就消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep going until it shines.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This side already looks glassy.
dialogue.zh: 這邊已經亮得像鏡子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your turn, I'll take the other.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arm is getting tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swap with me, take a break.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll sit one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water? You look a little hot.
dialogue.zh: 要喝水嗎？你看起來有點熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pass me that cold bottle.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，把那瓶冰水遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That drink tasted really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some for the drive home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, back to the shiny work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, door edges need wax too.
dialogue.zh: 對了，車門邊框也要上蠟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the door and reach inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, door frames fade first.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，門框總是最先褪色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are these tiny black dots?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably tar from new roads.
dialogue.zh: 應該是新柏油路的瀝青。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we remove those?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub them with a little oil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the corner of your towel.
dialogue.zh: 用你毛巾的角落輕輕擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are coming off slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's a big one by the wheel.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ə bɪɡ wʌn baɪ ðə wil./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squat down, I'll hold the cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are more on the bumper.
dialogue.zh: 保險桿上還有更多點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bugs stick there when we drive.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gross, let's soak them with soap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sponge and patience will fix it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember our old muddy car.
dialogue.zh: 還記得我們那台舊車的泥巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it looks like a showroom.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, it even reflects clouds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the fresh wax doing it.
dialogue.zh: 是剛打上去的蠟在發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wax the wheels too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, wax there won't last.
dialogue.zh: 不用，蠟在輪圈上留不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, glass needs a final wipe.
dialogue.zh: 好，玻璃最後還要收一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cloths: one damp, one dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which direction should I wipe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side to side on top glass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And up and down on the bottom?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ʌp ænd daʊn ɑn ðə ˈbɑtəm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that kills every streak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car smells fresh and clean.
dialogue.zh: 我們的車聞起來清新乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like lemons and new plastic.
dialogue.zh: 像檸檬混著新塑膠的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we miss the gas cap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch, wipe around it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the license plate is foggy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll polish it with my shirt.
dialogue.zh: 我直接拿襯衫把它擦亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One dirty spot is left now.
dialogue.zh: 現在只剩一個小污點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point it out, my hands are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ɪt aʊt, maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right above the rear taillight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, one wipe and done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the badges on the tailgate.
dialogue.zh: 也檢查一下尾門上的車標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dirt hides inside those letters.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A toothbrush will reach them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, brush gently there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step back and view the whole car.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp bæk ænd vju ðə hoʊl kɑr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I honestly love how it looks.
dialogue.zh: 我真心喜歡現在的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we call it done now?
dialogue.zh: 可以說我們洗完車了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one quick inspection first.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，先快速檢查一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inspect it with your bare hand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wet skin finds rough paint.
dialogue.zh: 對，濕手能摸出粗糙的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paint feels smooth everywhere.
dialogue.zh: 整台車的漆面都很滑順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more grit, we did it.
dialogue.zh: 再沒有顆粒了，我們做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These towels are soaked through.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll hang them at home later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have dry cloths?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two left inside the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for one last polish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sparkles like a new car.
dialogue.zh: 車子閃亮得像嶄新出廠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's carry these supplies inside.
dialogue.zh: 我們把這些用品拿到裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did we buy the towels here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, plus sponges and cleaner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must pay at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi mʌst peɪ æt ðə ˈkaʊntər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See the line by the register?
dialogue.zh: 看到收銀台前的隊伍了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people are in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least it's moving fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, the clerk works so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like this little shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always smells like pine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they sell air fresheners?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by the exit, in boxes.
dialogue.zh: 有，在出口邊一盒一盒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's get one for our car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pick it, I trust you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one smells like ocean air.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for our clean car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the clerk rings us up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see, how much?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That comes to twelve forty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we pay by phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, scan the code right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says payment approved.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She hands us a receipt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it in the glove box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we return the sponges?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the paper saves us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear the weather report?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain is coming by Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We washed at the right time.
dialogue.zh: 我們挑對洗車的日子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our wax will fight the rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the storm be heavy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They promised wind and rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our wipers still squeak, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過雨刷還是會吱吱叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll buy new ones this week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope today stays dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For now, it's bright and blue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See that dark cloud far away?
dialogue.zh: 看到遠處那朵烏雲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits over those hills.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still, let's not wait around.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, load our things back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekend driving will be nice.
dialogue.zh: 週末開車兜風一定很爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could take the coast route.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With a freshly cleaned car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone wants that drive.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we put wet mats?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the roof, tied down tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that legal on highways?
dialogue.zh: 上高速公路這樣合法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you knot them well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll use these two short ropes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the knots at each stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, I check twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sound like my father.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He taught me those knots.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good teachers make safe drivers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keys in hand, ready to go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One last look at the paint.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any spots left after the wax?
dialogue.zh: 打完蠟還有殘留污漬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not one, it glows everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the rims look silver.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrubbing those paid off well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we check the back too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, equally clean there.
dialogue.zh: 我看過了，那邊一樣乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm proud of our work today.
dialogue.zh: 我對我們今天的成果很驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We make a good team.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the door, mind the towel.
dialogue.zh: 開門時小心別碰到毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mmm, the inside still smells nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seats feel clean, too.
dialogue.zh: 座椅摸起來也乾乾淨淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more sand from the beach.
dialogue.zh: 沙灘帶回的沙子都不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll drive, you navigate home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the slow way, enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gee, the wheel feels smooth here.
dialogue.zh: 喲，方向盤摸起來好滑順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our fresh wax again.
dialogue.zh: 那又是我們新蠟的功勞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man waved at our car.
dialogue.zh: 有個路人朝我們的車揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He admires the deep shine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old car got no praise.
dialogue.zh: 我們的舊車從來沒被誇過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one earns smiles today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn on the radio, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This song fits our mood.
dialogue.zh: 這首歌正合我們的心情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Singing while driving a clean car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Life is good right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we plan the next wash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe after the rain passes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Birds will find us again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep soap by the door.
dialogue.zh: 那就把清潔劑放在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And towels always in the trunk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Being ready keeps us moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write these down for later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our shopping list grows again.
dialogue.zh: 我們的購物清單又變長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A short drive feels great.
dialogue.zh: 短短一段路開起來超舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh air fills the car.
dialogue.zh: 清新空氣充滿整個車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the sun feels softer now.
dialogue.zh: 連陽光都感覺溫柔了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because you're relaxed inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms hurt, but I feel glad.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz hɜrt, bʌt aɪ fil ɡlæd./
dialogue.zh: 手臂雖然痠痛，但心裡高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We earned our rest tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們理應好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, streetlights dance on it.
dialogue.zh: 你看，路燈在漆面上跳動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I could watch all night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's park where there are no trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts pɑrk wɛr ðɛr ɑr noʊ triz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No leaves, no bird surprises.
dialogue.zh: 沒有樹葉也沒有鳥糞驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Garage tonight, car safe inside.
dialogue.zh: 今晚進車庫，車子安全了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clean car rests at last.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的愛車終於能休息了。
